files.description: Loyalty memberships (200 rows): member_ref (six-digit reference with leading zeros), plan (bronze, silver, gold or platinum), city (city name; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent in some rows), points (whole number, multiples of 50; many members share the same points).

task_text: Tidy the city names (remove surrounding spaces and write each word with a capital first letter, as in 'Oslo'), then count the members for each combination of plan and city. `result` should be a Series of counts indexed by plan and city, ordered alphabetically by plan and then by city.
intended_computation: Normalise city to stripped title case (6 cities), count rows per (plan, city) pair that occurs (23 pairs, counts summing to 200), and order the pairs by plan ascending, then city ascending.

predicted_direction.reason: DataFrame.value_counts(sort=False) returned the pairs sorted by label on 2.x, as requested; on 3.x it keeps first-appearance order, which breaks the requested alphabetical order.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row R02; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
